scopedTests.environment: PGlite + synthetic HTTP + DOM VM + mocked Cron

liveAcceptance.prerequisite: reviewed authoring-015 and backup gate; 016 not required

limitations: Progress events are authenticated proxies, not verified dwell/completion or fraud-proof reads.
Provided cards are server responses, not viewport impressions or attributed first reads.
Metrics recheck current visibility/consent/Auth/favorite rows, not reconstructed historical state.
Policies are hypotheses; immutable dry-run outbox cannot send or promote.
Retention uses exact mature KST return days; fewer than 5 readers/authors is suppressed.
Sitemap fails closed above 1000 public works until partitioning is implemented.
Synthetic PGlite does not prove actual PostgreSQL concurrency, PostgREST grants, Cron, crawler or user acceptance.
